Lines.en: Oh my tacos, it's freezing out here!
I want to go back to the beach now!
This isn't a vacation trip, User Dave.
We're here to rescue plants, not relax.
If it's this cold, stay by Garden on that railcart, you'll be much warmer in no time.
But what about the brrrrrrreezing winds?
Garden's flames can heat the whole lawn if need be.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots large peas at the enemies
Blocks zombies and produces more sun
Quickly flings stunning butter at zombies
Shoots mighty lasers down the lane
Spreads by shooting spores at zombies
Rolls bouncing, explosive shots that redirect when hitting a zombie
